item.title: Rising Canine Parvovirus Cases in Guwahati Linked to Low Vaccination Awareness
item.description: Guwahati is witnessing a noticeable rise in canine parvovirus (CPV) infections, with veterinary hospitals and private clinics reporting a steady influx of infected dogs, particularly puppies. Experts attribute the surge to seasonal factors, delayed vaccinations, and a lack of awareness among pet owners about preventive care and responsible purchasing practices.
